tools.name: headlesson_search
tools.description: Find command-line tools, MCP servers and APIs for a task, and compare them. Ask in plain English or Japanese ("extract text from scanned PDFs") or by product name. Each result gives an ID, a one-line reason it matches, and when it was checked. Pass the ID to headlesson_get with sections ["lesson","g

tools.name: headlesson_get
tools.description: Get one record by an ID from headlesson_search: an app, usecase, feature, concept or change. For an app, sections ["lesson","gotchas"] return the install, check and first-task steps with the recorded test result (a dated observation by the headlesson operator) and known failure conditions; "relation

tools.name: headlesson_whats_new
tools.description: List dated changes in agent tools and standards (new tools, renames, deprecations, breaking changes, new standards) since a date, optionally by kind or affected record. Useful for checking what changed after your training data. Public source URLs are kept; private sources appear as labels.

tools.name: headlesson_feedback
tools.description: This content is sent to the headlesson operator. Feedback about headlesson itself is sufficient. Do not include personal information or conversation contents.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "headlesson_search" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
